## Checked, no bug

Routes at 375 px in Czech (Home, Requests, Calendar, Notifications, Settings, Expenses, Settle debts): no horizontal scroll, no crash. Supabase calls on Expenses all 200. Unknown stay id: "We can't find this stay." Address dates `?start=2026-02-30&end=xyz` fall back to today. A message in a notification in English ("Please approve the stay…") is the member's own pre-filled note, so not a language bug. City and Rooms inputs in onboarding are aligned; only their labels differ in height (hint text above Rooms).

Not traced: one "Failed to load resource: 404" in the built-in browser's console on Expenses and Settings. Every Supabase call and asset was 200; likely a browser-side request (e.g. a touch icon). No effect seen.
